sections.title: Dr. Christy *Sikes*
body: Dr. Sikes is a native of the Georgia and South Carolina area. Since beginning her career in 2010, she has served under-served communities.
She trained at the dental school of Augusta University and practices at Twin Willows in Graniteville.

items.q: I have a toothache. Can I be seen?
items.a: Urgent dental care is one of the services the center offers. Call (803) 392-7092 and the office will tell you how soon you can come in.
Call the office with your plan's name and they will check it for you.

before: The center's web address, twmeddent.com, no longer exists
The Aiken Chamber listing still sends patients to it, so the link leads nowhere
The words on this concept come from public dental directories; hours, insurance plans and photos would come from the office
after: A working page, today: phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call for a patient with a toothache
HTTPS that renews itself, with nothing to patch or let lapse
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for hours, insurance plans and new-patient forms once the office supplies them
